text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Thank you for inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That was a great change of pace!
Hopefully, this gets me back into top shape—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyooeeeee~!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The crows are mad...!
Ugh, did I do something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, excuse me, so sorry!
I j-j-just wanted to visit the shrine~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Both of you, please step back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: N-N-N-Now! G-G-G-Get behind me...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait, Top Road-san!
B-But Top Road-san, crows are—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!!
...Y-Yes, ...it's true, I'm bad at this!
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself, you step back too!
Don't overdo it, you should pull back too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, everyone!
We'll have to visit the shrine another time...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ! Please don't think like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You have a wish you want to fulfill, don't you?
In that case—I... absolutely won't back down!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is, no matter what difficulties arise,
I will overcome them all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now then, crows!
I'll be taking my leave through here...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh... Don't look away, don't look away!
My desire to protect the two of them is stronger than fear—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: She's so strooooong!!!!

text_block_list.name: Flock of Crows
text_block_list.text: Gwaah?! Quack, quack, quaaack!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...! Everyone just blew right past...!
choice_data_list: That was sheer willpower that won it……!
We won that on heart alone……!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaahhh...! I... I did ittt~~...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now, both of you! Pray with all your heart.
May your wishes come true!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I... have one more wish now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Rice too!
I think... we made the same wish, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice & Doto
text_block_list.text:
“—May something wonderful
happen to Top Road-san, too!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
It has already come true, you know.

text_block_list.name: Flock of Crows
text_block_list.text:
Caw, caw, caw, caw!!
Quack, quack, gwaa, gwaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she couldn't fulfill her wishes,
Narita Top Road's condition
remained poor...
